instruction: Create and enable a Thunderbird filter on the anonym-x2024@outlook.com account to copy every email with an attachment to the 'Important' folder.

metadata.explanation: This variation requires creating a filter to copy emails with attachments to the 'Important' folder. The evaluator verifies: (1) enabled='yes', (2) action='Copy to folder', (3) actionValue contains 'Important' folder (supports both exact match and partial match to handle Thunderbird's folder URI formats), and (4) condition includes attachment detection using flexible matching that accepts multiple valid methods (size-based: size,isGreaterThan; header-based: Content-Disposition, Content-Type; attachment status fields: attachmentStatus; or multipart detection). Uses custom check_thunderbird_filter__9b7bc335 function with comprehensive attachment detection logic.
metadata.verification: The custom check_thunderbird_filter__9b7bc335 function validates 'Copy to folder' actions with flexible attachment detection and destination folder verification. The function properly checks: (1) Filter enabled status, (2) Action type matches 'Copy to folder', (3) actionValue field contains the destination folder name 'Important' using case-insensitive partial matching to handle various Thunderbird folder URI formats (e.g., 'mailbox://nobody@Local%20Folders/Important', 'imap://user@server/INBOX/Important'), and (4) Filter conditions include attachment detection using the special 'check_attachments' marker which accepts any reasonable attachment-checking method including size-based (size,isGreaterThan), header-based (Content-Disposition, Content-Type), native attachment status fields (attachmentStatus), or multipart message detection. This comprehensive approach ensures the evaluator works across different Thunderbird versions and various user-created filter implementations while maintaining correctness.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks all core requirements: enabled status, action type 'Copy to folder', destination folder 'Important' (via actionValue field with flexible matching), and attachment detection conditions

The custom metric function implements comprehensive attachment detection via _has_attachment_check() that accepts multiple valid methods: size-based (size,isGreaterThan), header-based (Content-Disposition, Content-Type), native attachmentStatus fields, and multipart message detection
Flexible actionValue matching (lines 120-130) handles various Thunderbird folder URI formats correctly (mailbox://..., imap://...) with case-insensitive partial matching
Expected rules properly structured with all required fields: enabled='yes', action='Copy to folder', actionValue='Important', condition=['check_attachments']

Minor issue: Account verification is implicit via file path '/home/user/.thunderbird/.../ImapMail/outlook.office365.com/msgFilterRules.dat' rather than explicit, but this is acceptable as the file path strongly indicates correct account
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding explicit account verification by parsing the file path or account name from filter file, though current implicit verification via file path is functionally adequate
